uvh26.title: The Urban Vision Hackathon Dataset and Models: Towards Image Annotations and Accurate Vision Models for Indian Traffic

clip.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
clip.training_data: WIT (WebImageText), 400M image-text pairs collected from the internet

contamination.conclusion: UVH-26 frames were captured in February 2025, four years after CLIP's training data was collected (model dated January 2021), so no test frame can be in CLIP's training set.
contamination.caveat: The concepts (auto-rickshaws, Indian buses, CCTV-style images) were certainly in CLIP's web data, so this tests transfer to a new camera domain, not unseen classes.
contamination.own_leakage: Prompts and the review threshold are chosen on val cameras only. Test pseudo-cameras are disjoint from val by construction; residual same-camera leakage from Assignment 1's audit is 17.5% (95% CI 8.7-32%, 40 random test images vs their most similar train image). The audit measured test vs train; nothing is trained here, so it bounds val-to-test camera overlap only loosely.
contamination.a1_clip_use: Assignment 1 used CLIP ViT-B/32 embeddings only to compare grouping rules; the frozen split used 64x36 gradient-magnitude correlation, so no CLIP signal shaped the test set.
